text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PDR-4821 fired for service=redwood-inference-gpu-pool-us-west2a — symptom: repeated CUDA OOM / NVML alloc failures across several nodes (gpu-pool-usw2a-3..6). Rate ~45/min. https://pd.example/INCIDENT/PDR-4821
pagerduty: Incident PDR-4821 created -> severity=high; assigned to oncall group 'eng-oncall'.
alex: ack
alex: pulled logs from gpu-pool-usw2a-5 — seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in container redwood-runtime-022 and rapid restart loop.
priya: is this one node or broader in the pool?
sam: metrics show per-GPU memory spikes then immediate OOM. KV cache size for some requests steadily grows. Querying k8s.
sam: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu-pool-usw2a-5`
sam: pod redwood-runtime-022 restarts=5, status=OOMKilled
jordan: starting quick mitigation: cordon node gpu-pool-usw2a-5 and drain non-critical pods to reduce noisy neighbor risk.
alex: executed `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-usw2a-5` then `kubectl drain gpu-pool-usw2a-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — drain in progress.
support: are we seeing customer impact? Dashboards show a small uptick in 502/504s for some dedicated customers in us-west2a.
priya: contacting affected customers now (CS). Preliminary: ~0.5% of total requests in us-west2a; increased tail latency on long-context jobs.
sam: temporary mitigation: enable routing fallback to smaller quantized model for the pool to reduce memory pressure.
alex: updated routing: `rwctl routes update --pool=us-west2a --fallback_model=redwood-quant-v2` — new requests should hit fallback.
priya: CS notification sent with short note and ETA ~30m for full remediation.
jordan: filed bug tracker item — suspected KV cache leak when handling >16k token contexts. Ping @ml-eng for immediate follow-up.
ml-eng: investigating; will collect allocation traces and reproduce. Applying temporary rate-limit on long-context requests >32k tokens for this pool.
alex: acknowledged in PD, setting paging silence for 15m while we monitor.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PDR-4821 acknowledged by alex. Summary: node cordoned, routing fallback enabled, customers notified.
sam: monitoring shows OOMs dropped to ~2/min after routing change; tail latency improving. Will escalate if >5/min.
priya: handing off follow-up to jordan for post-incident analysis and postmortem. Jordan, you good to take it?
jordan: taking it. Creating follow-up ticket and scheduling postmortem with ML eng and SRE. Closing active triage in this thread.
incident-bot: PDR-4821 state=monitoring. Last update recorded at ts=2755554681.
